LanguageData.SRR_ModEnabled_Tip: Master switch to toggle all relation pruning and WorldPawnGC protections. Changes take effect immediately.
LanguageData.SRR_CleanColonistOnPermDeath_Label: Clean relations when colonist corpse cannot be resurrected
LanguageData.SRR_CleanColonistOnPermDeath_Tip: Severs relations between colonists once a deceased colonist's corpse is desiccated, butchered, cremated, or permanently destroyed.
LanguageData.SRR_CleanColonistToWorld_Label: Clean colonist-to-world-pawn relations on map departure or death
LanguageData.SRR_CleanColonistToWorld_Tip: Maintains relationships while world-pawn relatives are alive on a colonist map, and severs them once they exit the map or die (or when the colonist dies).
LanguageData.SRR_CleanWorldToWorld_Label: Clean world-pawn-to-world-pawn relations on map departure or death
LanguageData.SRR_CleanWorldToWorld_Tip: Maintains relations between world pawns while both are alive on a colonist map, and severs them once either leaves the map or dies.
LanguageData.SRR_CleanOffMapWorldPawns_Tip: Severs relations between non-colonist world pawns neither of whom is present on a colonist map.
LanguageData.SRR_ProtectFactionLeaders_Label: Protect living faction leaders from garbage collection
LanguageData.SRR_ProtectFactionLeaders_Tip: Ensures living faction leaders are never discarded by WorldPawnGC even when they have no remaining family ties.
LanguageData.SRR_IncludeNonBlood_Label: Include marriage / spouse relations in cleanup
LanguageData.SRR_IncludeNonBlood_Tip: Applies cleanup rules to spouse, fiance, lover, ex-spouse, and ex-lover relations in addition to blood relations. Animal bonds and mechanitor overseer links are never removed.
LanguageData.SRR_VerboseLogging_Tip: Outputs relationship severing and GC protection details to the RimWorld developer log.
